# Md Abdul Munim

> Engineering leader (Software Development Manager III at Amazon) with 14+ years in the industry and 7+ years in engineering leadership. Experience leading multi-squad tribes and org-wide platform/SRE initiatives across Europe and Southeast Asia.

## Key facts
- 14+ years industry experience, 7+ years engineering leadership, 20+ systems architected, 6+ developer platform (PaaS) solutions delivered.
- Leading Network Observability Alerts at Amazon, spanning 34 AWS regions at 99.999% availability.
- BSc Computer Science & Engineering, BUET (Bangladesh University of Engineering & Technology).
